# `pygeovision monitor`

Detect **data drift**: whether the imagery you are now feeding a model differs from the imagery it was trained or
validated on. See [Monitoring](../../monitoring/index.md).

## When to use it

Use it periodically in production, comparing a reference folder with a recent one.

## What you get

A per-band statistic table and an overall verdict; `-o` saves the report.

## Things to know

* Drift is a warning that inputs changed (season, sensor, haze), not proof that predictions got worse. Check accuracy on
  new labelled samples as well ([drift](../../monitoring/drift.md)).
* An incomplete comparison (a file that could not be read) exits with code 1 rather than reporting "no drift".

## Commands

```text
Usage: pygeovision monitor [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Model monitoring — drift detection, performance tracking.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  drift  Detect data distribution drift.
```

### `pygeovision monitor drift`

```text
Usage: pygeovision monitor drift [OPTIONS] REFERENCE_DIR CURRENT_DIR

  Detect data distribution drift.

Options:
  -o, --output TEXT
  --help             Show this message and exit.
```
